details: `jpeg.decode` allocates a large image's planes and a progressive image's coefficients only as far as its scans fill them, as Go's lazily zeroed pages do, so a small file whose header asks for a large image and whose scans fail early no longer costs the whole image first (a 20 KB file asking for 10000x10000: 1.1 s and 1.5 GB before, under 1 ms and 4 MB now). Affected: 0.38.0 to 0.51.1.
changelog: - Security (std/jpeg, every backend): `jpeg.decode` allocates a large image's planes and a progressive image's coefficients only as far as its scans fill them, as Go's lazily zeroed pages do, so a small file whose header asks for a large image and whose scans fail early no longer costs the whole image first (a 20 KB file asking for 10000x10000: 1.1 s and 1.5 GB before, under 1 ms and 4 MB now). Affected: 0.38.0 to 0.51.1.
